fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on delayed restoration of traffic at Baker's Haulover between Miami Beach and the north, criticism of public inefficiency and voter apathy, and discussion of traffic/parking conditions affecting tourists and commercial vehicles. Reports note official actions on food safety (destruction of unfit canned goods) and other public health matters. The issue prints letters to the editor concerning utility deposits, employment agency practices, and calls for investigation of the Miami police department, alongside local political commentary (including the gubernatorial race and eligibility questions). Contains society/column items and extensive local advertising and holiday-related content.
